topic: Does swallowed gum stay in you for seven years?

sources.title: Myth or Fact: It Takes Seven Years to Digest Chewing Gum
Fact or Fiction?: Chewing Gum Takes Seven Years to Digest

claims.text: The folk claim is that swallowed gum stays in you for seven years.
claims.quote: there the gum will remain for the next seven years; it will stay in your system for seven years

claims.text: Sweeteners are broken down, but the gum base is largely indigestible.
claims.quote: Some of the components, such as sweeteners, are broken down, but the gum's base is largely indigestible

claims.text: Most people empty their stomachs 30 to 120 minutes after eating, gum included.
claims.quote: Most people empty their stomachs 30 to 120 minutes after eating, and that includes gum

claims.text: Gum travels the same path as food and is excreted.
claims.quote: gum simply travels the same path as food and is excreted in stool; eventually the normal housekeeping waves in the digestive tract will sort of push it through

claims.text: Doctors rarely see swallowed gum more than a week old.
claims.quote: usually it's not something that's any more than a week old; McGreal says it’s unlikely that gum would stay in the stomach for seven years

claims.text: A 1998 Pediatrics report described children given gum as a reward who swallowed it regularly.
claims.quote: As Milov and his colleagues wrote in Pediatrics in 1998; two of whom received gum as positive reinforcement for good behavior and regularly disposed of the treat by swallowing it

claims.text: The gum built into a taffy-like mass that had to be removed.
claims.quote: the gum snowballed into a substantial "taffylike" mass that required extraction

claims.text: In a girl of a year and a half, gum fused four coins into one blob in the esophagus.
claims.quote: a girl just a year and a half old, four coins were found lodged in the esophagus, fused into a single blob by a wad of chewing gum

myths.myth: Swallowed gum stays in your stomach for seven years.
myths.truth: It passes like other indigestible things, usually within days.
